name: A00_6_a_countered_recast_is_exiled_not_graveyarded
notes: Printed: 'If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.' The -2 waits on the stack (hold), resolves and casts the graveyard Shock at the opposing Bear (the {R} in the pool pays); Shock waits on the stack and the opponent counters it with Cancel (three of its four Islands). A countered spell would be put into its owner's graveyard, so it is exiled instead; the Bear lives; Cancel goes to the opponent's graveyard (it is no spell of Chandra's).
